symptom: 自维护循环code步骤重复失败，open_items中不断新增failed_steps=code条目，retry_count始终为1，无法达到max_retries阈值升级到人工处理，造成无限循环执行code步骤
root_cause: _update_loop_memory中匹配code步骤失败项的逻辑错误要求existing item必须没有para_task_id，但code步骤执行后在返回失败时通常已经创建了para_task_id（但尚未创建branch），导致无法匹配已有失败项，每次都新增条目而不是累加重试次数
fix_diff:
diff --git a/成都修茈科技有限公司/MODstore_deploy/modstore_server/self_maintenance_loop_runner.py b/成都修茈科技有限公司/MODstore_deploy/modstore_server/self_maintenance_loop_runner.py
--- a/成都修茈科技有限公司/MODstore_deploy/modstore_server/self_maintenance_loop_runner.py
+++ b/成都修茈科技有限公司/MODstore_deploy/modstore_server/self_maintenance_loop_runner.py
@@ -3407,15 +3407,12 @@ def _update_loop_memory(memory: Dict[str, Any], final: Dict[str, Any], gate: Dic
                         existing_idx = idx
                         break
         # If still not found and failing at code step (no branch yet), match existing open code failure
         if existing_idx is None and failed_steps == ["code"]:
             for idx, item in reversed(list(enumerate(open_items))):
                 if (
                     isinstance(item, dict)
                     and item.get("kind") == "failed_steps"
                     and item.get("steps") == ["code"]
                     and not item.get("branch")
-                    and not item.get("task_id")
-                    and not item.get("para_task_id")
                 ):
-                    existing_idx = idx
-                    break
+                    # Early code failures (before branch creation) always match the most recent open code failure,
+                    # regardless of para_task_id, since no branch exists to resume against
+                    existing_idx = idx
+                    break

executable_template.applicability_check: 当自维护循环open_items中存在多个kind=failed_steps且steps=["code"]、retry_count=1的条目，且循环持续重复执行code步骤无法推进到review/qa阶段时适用
executable_template.patch_strategy: 移除code失败项匹配逻辑中对para_task_id为空的要求，允许匹配到最近的无分支code失败项，从而正确累加重试次数
executable_template.rollback_plan: 恢复原匹配条件，重新添加`and not item.get("para_task_id")`判断即可回滚
